temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual and less vibrant at work. When he asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff but does not give details, and she appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose generally sees Patricia as vibrant and does not have a specific concern about her well-being.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed — he now believes Patricia may be troubled by a personal issue, though she has not disclosed what it is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is likely dealing with something personal and seems to appreciate support, but she is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer a supportive listening ear without pushing her to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments. When he offers to discuss financial planning, she confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and is open to budgeting help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia may be dealing with an unspecified personal problem and appreciates his support, but Jose does not know the nature of the issue.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed — he learns that financial stress is likely part of Patricia's problem, and his concern deepens.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is facing financial strain and may be willing to discuss budgeting or financial planning with him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Increased concern, empathy, and some hopefulness about helping
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer practical help with budgeting and financial planning if she wants it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose worries that he may have overstepped by bringing up Patricia's finances. Patricia reassures him that she did not think he was prying and says she is grateful for his offer. Jose reiterates that he respects her privacy and wants to support her as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After offering financial help, Jose is uncertain whether he crossed a boundary and may be worried Patricia felt intruded upon.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed — Patricia's reassurance corrects his worry; he now believes she welcomed his support and did not feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern and sees him as a supportive friend she can turn to, while he should continue respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry giving way to relief and gratitude
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Patricia as a friend without prying, while making clear he is available if she needs him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in casually and asks about her weekend. Patricia says everything is good and that she plans a quiet weekend at home, without sharing more personal details. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and may be open to friendly check-ins, though he remains mindful about respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed or slightly strengthened — Patricia's brief, non-detailed response reinforces that she prefers to manage her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but wants to handle her problems on her own terms; she will reach out if she needs him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a friendly and supportive presence without pressing for details, letting Patricia initiate deeper conversations.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in with Patricia at work and reminds her he is available to help with anything, even something small like grabbing coffee. Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers privacy, so he should remain supportive without being intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change — Patricia's response confirms that she values his support and is managing her situation, while still not asking for specific help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her own issues and appreciates Jose's steady, low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular, casual check-ins and offer help without pressure, remaining available if she reaches out.
